title: ReplayPolicy
description: Content of replay.yaml inside a NovaFabric Run Capsule. Governs what replay does with external resources and mutating tools.

external_resources.description: Default policy for any external resource without an explicit override.

mutating_tools.description: Default policy for mutating tool re-execution.

defaults.description: Default policies applied when no per-resource or per-tool override matches.

external_resources.description: Per-resource policy overrides. First matching override wins.

cost_caps.description: Cost guardrails for replay. Enforced in semantic and exact modes.

network.description: Outbound network access policy during replay.

time.description: Clock and time injection for replay.

exact.description: Policy overrides applied only when mode is 'exact'.

mocked.description: Policy overrides applied only when mode is 'mocked'.

semantic.description: Policy overrides applied only when mode is 'semantic'.

forensic.description: Policy overrides applied only when mode is 'forensic'.

mode_overrides.description: Per-mode patches merged into the base policy at replay time.

ExternalResourceKind.description: How an external resource is stored and handled at replay. 'snapshot': full bytes in capsule. 'reference': refetch from URI and verify hash. 'hash': user supplies local copy; hash verified.

OnHashMismatch.description: 'refuse' aborts replay; 'warn' records drift and continues.

snapshot_size_cap_bytes.description: Maximum bytes for snapshot capture. Default 104857600 (100 MiB).

freshness_window.description: ISO 8601 duration. A reference resource is fresh if age <= window. Default P30D.

local_resolver.description: Template for resolving local copies when kind is 'hash'. Substitution variables: {XDG_DATA_HOME}, {HOME}, {asset_ref}, {name}, {version}, {content_hash}, {capsule_dir}, {cwd}.

allow.description: Global toggle for re-executing mutating tools. Default false. CLI --allow-mutating-tools flips to true.

require_per_tool_confirm.description: If true, every mutating tool allowed via 'allow' still requires interactive confirmation.

redact_argument_keys.description: Argument keys whose values are masked in the policy log.

kind.description: How to match an external resource.

pattern.description: Regex pattern. Used by kinds: url, host, dataset (with pattern), vector-index, path.

asset_ref.description: Full asset_ref for exact matching. Used by kinds: asset_ref, dataset (with asset_ref).

asset_type.description: Asset type enum for matching all assets of a type. Used by kind: asset_type.

server_name.description: MCP server name. Used by kind: mcp-server.

allow.description: Whether to re-execute this tool. Wins over the global default.

confirm.description: Override require_per_tool_confirm for this specific tool.

rationale.description: Required when allow is true and mutation_class is 'external-side-effect'. Recorded in replay_drift.

total_max_usd.description: Aggregate cost cap for the whole replay in USD.

per_call_max_usd.description: Per-call cost cap; abort if any single call estimate exceeds this.

egress.description: Outbound network access mode. 'policy' evaluates each call against external_resources.

proxy.description: Proxy URL applied to all replay HTTP.

freeze_clock.description: If true, replay overrides time.time() and datetime.now() to return injected_now.

injected_now.description: Specific time to inject. If null and freeze_clock is true, captured wallclock_at_start is used.

ModeOverridePatch.description: Subset of top-level fields that can be overridden per replay mode.
